label: Kimi K3.1 Pro
output:
Ajay, “cricket captain after losing the series” was uncalled for. Accurate, but uncalled for.

@Rohan straight answer, because you and Divya deserve one, not the LinkedIn version: FixKaro is still alive, but I’m not at “all good bro” level. Your ₹3 lakh from the 2025 friends round is still invested, on the same terms as everyone else. The money is at risk, not gone. I genuinely don’t know whether we’ll pull this off, so I’m not going to promise it’s safe. If the company doesn’t make it, you could lose it. No funeral today, but no victory parade either.

What happened: the bridge round from the Hyderabad fund fell through on 28 Oct, when the term sheet was basically ready. That knocked out the funding we were counting on. The VC partner had told us “we love the energy” and then stopped replying for 11 days. Apparently the energy could not be converted into funds.

Last Friday we let go of 6 of our 14 people. Everyone received two months’ pay, and we’ve already helped four of them get interviews. It was the worst day of my life, worse than failing maths in 2nd sem. At least that disaster affected only my own future and Amma’s blood pressure.

Where we stand now: after the cuts, we have roughly five months of runway. The app has around 41k monthly users. Plumbers and electricians are growing; AC servicing is bleeding money. The plan is to shut AC servicing and focus on housing-society tie-ups. Three societies in HSR have already signed pilots. Those are pilots, not proof that we’ve won, but they’re real. I honestly think we have a decent shot with this direction. It’s just not a sure thing, and I won’t insult you by presenting it like one.

I’ll call you and Divya properly this week and walk you through the numbers, runway and plan. Actual numbers, not a pitch deck. Ask me whatever you want, including the uncomfortable stuff. You trusted me with real money, and Divya asking about it over dinner is completely reasonable. You shouldn’t have to decode my “difficult decisions” post to figure out what’s happening to your own investment.

For everyone else: I’m okay. Tired, but okay. I’m eating 11 pm office Maggi so regularly that security uncle has stopped asking if I’m eating and now just asks “masala or plain?” Amma asked last week whether TCS is still hiring, so confidence levels across different stakeholders vary considerably.

Saturday I’m coming. I need proper dosa, proper beer and one evening where nobody says “runway”. Pranav is buying, which is now recorded in the group chat and therefore legally binding in my head. Rohan, keep the sad face in drafts for now. Pranav’s card may still get declined.
